mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 240 signals anticipated inflation pressure, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 240 within the next month, or SPX 20d returns positive despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 1-month moving averages indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above their 1-month moving averages
failure_condition: The interaction effect (IC) between GDPC1 and INDPRO falls below 0.05 over any 3-month window, or SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained combination of low federal funds rates (<0.3%) and depressed GDP growth (GDPC1 <17000) signals peak inflation concerns, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.3% or GDPC1 exceeds 17000 in the regime, or SPX returns negative despite the regime conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% triggers investor concerns about tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not cross above 0.5% within the next week, or SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rates above 5% signals labor market weakness, reducing growth prospects and prompting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 5% within the next month, or SPX returns positive despite the labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent surges in both demand (GDPC1) and labor demand (PAYEMS) above their 1-month moving averages indicate robust consumption and employment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS above their 1-month moving averages
failure_condition: The interaction effect (IC) between GDPC1 and PAYEMS falls below 0.05 over any 3-month window, or SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the INDPRO index above 105 signals increased supply-side activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 105 within the next month, or SPX returns negative despite the supply signal.
